claims: sharpness (entropy, max-p, share above greedy_threshold) of the Gumbel policy target at k=8, n=24 on 200 random-play positions per seed, for 10 untrained networks (one per seed), under the current settings and the paper's
non_claims: not evidence of playing strength or of learning
untrained networks only; a trained network's targets may be sharper or flatter
positions come from random play, not from self-play
interior (non-root) selection is this repository's PUCT in every variant
the paper does not state how Go/chess Q is normalised; paper_affine is one reading of it, mctx_minmax_c1 is mctx's rescale at the paper's c_scale
the seed field is the first of several; every seed is listed under seeds
per-position rows are omitted; they are regenerated from the seeds

normalisation.mctx_minmax_c1: per-node min-max (mctx) with the paper's c_scale 1.0

paper.target: softmax(log pi + sigma) over all legal actions

settings.position_source: seeded uniform-random play to a uniform target turn
